scientific_question: Does the independently supported decay-0.5 residual memory stabilize the accepted bilateral c_proj chart on mature integrated paths, or is the remaining c_proj gap a chart-family failure?

theory.fixed_chart: Keep hidden64+24 and output32 bilateral passes, the exact same-gauge full-state snapshots, and the observed best eight-substep straight-chord cadence fixed. No basis, allocation, connectivity, or task-selected direction is added.
theory.candidate: At substep t use corrected request u_t + 0.5 e_t and set e_(t+1) to corrected request minus the realized chart update. This is the same bounded residual-memory coefficient that won terminally at 350M and transferred to 690M.
theory.control: A zero-feedback arm uses the identical chart and requests but discards compression residual. It determines whether residual memory itself is useful rather than merely bounded.
theory.transport: A non-reset decay-0.5 arm starts at step zero and follows all four dense phase chords without resetting its weight or feedback to a dense endpoint. This is the causal coarse-transport discriminator.
theory.closure: If decay 0.5 cannot pass exact phase-local and non-reset fixed-CE gates, close the bilateral mature-path family. Do not sweep cadence or invent another basis from this trajectory.

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: The chart has nontrivial integrated capacity, but full carry dominates shrinking requests and drifts. Decay 0.5 is the only already-supported scalar intervention; zero carry is its minimal ablation.

measurements: phase-local endpoint recovery for zero and decay-0.5 carry at every phase and layer
exact fixed-window decay-0.5 validation CE at all four phase endpoints
terminal exact CE for zero-feedback and non-reset sequential decay-0.5 controls
terminal feedback norms and minimum layer-phase recovery

decision_rule.threshold_basis: Recovery 0.55 is the previously supported bounded-carry level. The feedback cap is one half of the observed full-carry straight8 maximum. Functional thresholds retain the preregistered 0.005 terminal, 0.01 phase, and 0.02 transport tolerances.

interpretation.joint_pass: authorize only a bounded chart-transport theory; implementation and training remain separately gated
interpretation.phase_pass_transport_fail: the chart has target-selected phase capacity but lacks causal transport; do not implement or train
interpretation.phase_fail: close the bilateral mature-path family and do not run another cadence or basis sweep

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
